title: Paystride Save Account Agreement — Opening an Account
content:
## Opening clauses of the Paystride Save account agreement

**1. One account per worker.** A worker holds at most 1 (one) Paystride Save account. A worker may not hold a second Paystride Save account that is not closed.

**2. Active card.** An account is opened only while the worker's Paystride Visa Payroll Card account status is active.

**3. Starting position.** A new account opens in pending at Paystride Save Starter with a zero balance, round-ups and auto-save off unless the worker turns them on, and is reviewed for a higher tier at the first monthly review.

**4. Reopening wait.** A worker whose last account closed fewer than 30 calendar days ago cannot open another.

## What the records must show

These are conditions read from the company's records at the time of the application, not from what the worker says:

| Condition | Record read | What satisfies it |
|---|---|---|
| Clause 1 | the worker's existing Paystride Save accounts and their statuses | no Paystride Save account of the worker in pending, open or frozen status; an account in closed status does not count as a second account |
| Clause 2 | the status of the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account the new savings account is to be linked to | that card account's status is active |
| Clause 4 | the closed date of the worker's last Paystride Save account | that account did not close fewer than 30 calendar days ago |

A Paystride Save account is linked to one Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account, and clause 2 reads the status of that linked card account.

## Applying the clauses (hypothetical cases)

- A worker's only earlier Paystride Save account is frozen. A frozen account is not closed, so clause 1 bars a second account.
- A worker's only earlier Paystride Save account is pending identity verification. A pending account is not closed, so clause 1 bars a second account.
- A worker's card account shows a status other than active. Clause 2 is not met, and the account is not opened.
- A worker's last Paystride Save account closed 29 calendar days ago. That is fewer than 30, so clause 4 bars a new account. Had it closed exactly 30 calendar days ago, it would not be fewer than 30, and clause 4 would not bar it.

## On opening

An account opened under these clauses starts pending, at Paystride Save Starter, with a balance of zero; its round-ups and auto-save are off unless the worker turns them on. Its first opportunity to move to a higher tier is the first monthly review.
